records.title: Concentric Fire Pit - 36
records.description: A dyad of mixed metals. The Concentric Fire Pit is composed of a weathered steel ring nested within a stainless steel outer shell. Like yin and yang, distinct characters in balance with each other. A functional sculpture to hold the element of fire, this fire pit evokes the concentric geometries of wood and water — like growth rings on a tree stump, or ripples through a pond. Outdoor-appropriate metals in their rawest form will age gracefully in interaction with the elements.

records.description: James Plattner on Instagram: "I’m excited to announce that my newest typeface, Asoma is now available! Asoma aims to revive the sense of wonder and mystery of 1970s monoweight typefaces such as ITC Busorama, ITC Serif Gothic, and Marvin. Loosely inspired by its predecessors, Asoma contains many new forms as well as plenty of ligatures and alternates for locked up layouts. Additionally, Asoma includes a full upper and lowercase character set, lining figures, math characters, punctuation, variable compatibility, 5 distinct weights and support for Western European, Central European, South Eastern European and South American scripts. Asoma is 20% off for the next two weeks! I also offer a 40% discount for all students. Just DM or email me at jplatt79@gmail.com and I will get you situated ✌️ .
